dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is Chiang Mai bigger than Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈbɪɡər ðən ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it's smaller. And it's quieter.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈsmɔːlər. ənd ɪts ˈkwaɪətər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. Bangkok is noisier and hotter, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈnɔɪziər ənd ˈhɑːtər, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I think it's safer than Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈseɪfər ðən ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In the old city, they're narrower than in Bangkok. But they're nice for walking.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ði ˈoʊld ˈsɪti, ðɛr ˈnæroʊər ðən ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk. bʌt ðɛr ˈnaɪs fər ˈwɔːkɪŋ.
